Quick recap (from our discovery call)
- Primary use case: customer support ranking + long-context retrieval (~8k tokens per request)
- Current pain: unpredictable p90 latency during peak (batching currently ad-hoc)
- Non-functional reqs: EU data residency for logs, SOC2-level audit trail, key management w/ HSM
- Success metrics: p95 generation latency < 350ms at 30 QPS; cost target ~ $0.002/token (target to discuss)

Proposed next step
- 60–90 minute technical deep dive with infra + ML owners (we'll cover architecture, throughput/latency targets, SLOs, rollout/fallback plans, and acceptance criteria)
- Attendees we plan to bring: Marissa (Ops lead), Priyom (Solutions eng — model serving), myself (AEs)
- Request from you: please include your ML infra lead and a dev who owns inference footprint (to share sample traces)

Suggested windows (all PDT):
- Tue Apr 6, 10:00–11:15
- Wed Apr 7, 14:00–15:15
- Thu Apr 8, 09:00–10:00 (60m)

If any of those work, I can lock a calendar invite and circulate an agenda + prep packet. I attached a one-page scope matrix for your review (crestline_scope_matrix.xlsx) — nothing sensitive, just to orient the discussion.

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa for ops alignment.
